description: Display an article-level notice. Use Section notice for a notice confined to one section.
documentation_wikitext:
__NOTOC__
Display an article-level notice. Use Section notice for a notice confined to one section.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Ambox|text=Example notice.|image_content=[[Milady Maker|Icon link]]|small=no|plainlinks=no}}
</syntaxhighlight>

Omit optional parameters that do not apply. The parameter reference below lists supported names and aliases.

parameters.description: Kind of subject or work, using the article's terminology.
parameters.label: Type
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Content to display; accepts wikitext and nested templates unless described otherwise.
parameters.label: Text
parameters.name: text

parameters.description: Native wiki image filename, without File: or surrounding brackets.
parameters.label: Image
parameters.name: image

parameters.description: Rendered media content, such as Preservation image; takes precedence over the native image.
parameters.label: Image content
parameters.name: image_content

parameters.description: Native notice image size, for example 40px.
parameters.label: Imagesize
parameters.name: imagesize

parameters.description: Use yes for the compact notice variant.
parameters.label: Small
parameters.name: small

parameters.description: Use no to retain ordinary external-link decoration; defaults to yes.
parameters.label: Plainlinks
parameters.name: plainlinks
